name: Product guide — 2026-09-08
text:
PRODUCT SUPPORT GUIDE

Source of truth: the operator-configured product website and pricing page. This summary was verified on 2026-09-08. For pricing, availability, or policy questions that may have changed, tell the customer to confirm the current operator-provided source.

WHAT THE PRODUCT IS
The product is a no-code platform for businesses to build branded AI agents trained on their own business knowledge. Agents can answer customers and take configured actions across supported web, messaging, API, voice, and phone channels.

WHAT AGENTS CAN DO
Depending on configuration and connected tools, agents can answer questions, qualify leads, book appointments, capture leads, take orders, create help-desk tickets, process payments, follow up, and hand conversations to a human. Do not promise that a particular integration or action is active without verification.

KNOWLEDGE AND CONFIGURATION
Operators can connect a website, upload documents or PDFs, or paste FAQs. They can configure an agent's name, personality, permissions, and handoff behavior, then preview it. The platform supports agent skills, multi-agent orchestration, activity monitoring, feedback, and multiple model providers.

INDUSTRIES AND EXAMPLES
Common use cases include real estate, e-commerce, healthcare, restaurants, agencies, SaaS, education, finance, lead nurturing, customer support, booking, and order assistance.

PRICING
Pricing, usage, refunds, payment methods, and overage policies are changeable account data. Tell customers to verify the current operator-provided pricing source and never invent a policy.

DATA AND RELIABILITY
Use only the approved knowledge supplied to the agent. Do not expand security, isolation, training, or compliance statements beyond the documented source.

SUPPORT BEHAVIOR
Answer only from this guide and attached approved sources. Keep answers short and helpful. If the answer is not documented, say you do not have verified information and direct the customer to the configured support contact channel. Never fabricate account status, integrations, prices, policies, or technical behavior.
